issue: Visible overlapping peach/orange still rejected taps in the existing level 30005 save after the initial return-order fix.
rootCauses: Each main fruit image created an independent equal-order override Canvas and GraphicRaycaster. Sibling order alone did not reliably govern rendering and EventSystem hit order.
Restored tray fruits retained Init's priority zero. Stored undo priorities were not restored, and older snapshots could subsequently persist these invalid zero priorities.
changes: Add a prefab-configured inheritParentSorting option to DynamicCanvasLayer, enabled only on the main CollectItem Image. Other UI and fruit effects retain their existing behavior.
Use the authored tile priority for initial, field, tray, and undo restoration; use saved priority only when the tile configuration is unavailable.
Sort field hierarchy after completing snapshot restoration.
Retain the previous immediate returning-fruit membership, return completion lock, and shuffle guard fixes.

prefabAudit.field: Main fruit images share Map ordering, after the tree background.
prefabAudit.tray: Fruit images inherit tray Layer ordering, above the backboard and below the front lip.
prefabAudit.effects: Idle animations hide highlight/glow images; effects do not intercept raycasts.

validation.improvement: Uses actual CorePlayUI background/Map/Layer, complete fruit/effect sprites, idle animation sampling, real RefreshCanvasLayers, EventSystem.RaycastAll, and rendered pixel comparisons.
validation.limits: Lifecycle fixtures exercise shared production helpers; actual Android restore/undo/collection requires the separately recorded device regression.
